mechanism: UTC trading-session bucket (Asian/European/US) conditioning of the funding effect applied to NEXT-HOUR NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED OBSERVED LIQUIDATION INTENSITY (sum of notional_usd, not event count) on the frozen combined metpie+ironflow panel; distinct regime variable (UTC session bucket vs RV tercile) and distinct estimand from FCLR-XSEC-004 (count-based, RV tercile) and FCLR-XSEC-005 (notional-weighted, RV tercile)
distinct_from: FCLR-STARTER-001 (time-series 24h forward RV forecast, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-001 (pooled within-hour cross-sectional funding contrast on RV, verdict NOT_SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-002 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour RV, verdict SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-003 (thin RV-only holdout, SUPERSEDED, never executed)
FCLR-XSEC-004 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour liquidation intensity, COUNT-BASED, RV tercile, verdict SUPPORTED)
FCLR-XSEC-005 (regime-conditioned funding contrast on next-hour liquidation intensity, NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED, RV tercile, verdict SUPPORTED)
FCLR-LIQ-COMBINED-PANEL (time-series 24h liquidation intensity QLIKE C2 vs B1, NOT_MET)
regime_variable: UTC trading-session bucket at hour t = clock-hour of the UTC timestamp: Asian [00:00,08:00), European [08:00,16:00), US [16:00,24:00). Bucket assigned ex-ante by clock hour, independent of RV.
regime_split_primary: three UTC session buckets: Asian, European, US; hours with fewer than 3 coins present are excluded from regime/bucket eligibility
predictor_primary: abs_fund_pct within-(hour, session-bucket) cross-sectional rank; high_funding = top half of coins by rank, low_funding = bottom half within the same (hour, session-bucket)
outcome_primary: next-hour NOTIONAL-WEIGHTED observed liquidation intensity per coin = sum of notional_usd over all observed liquidation events of that coin in the closed UTC hour t+1 (shift -1 within coin) — DOLLAR SEVERITY, NOT EVENT COUNT
outcome_secondary: next-hour observed liquidation event count per coin (count-based robustness of the same contrast, for cross-reference only)
baseline: within-session-bucket RV persistence (coin's own rv24h at t split high/low within (hour, session-bucket)) predicting next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity — specificity control
family: session buckets x {funding contrast, RV persistence baseline} = 3 buckets x 2 contrasts
materiality_definition: abs(mean_diff_high_minus_low) / mean_abs_outcome over the bucket's coin-hours, where mean_abs_outcome is the mean absolute next-hour notional-weighted liquidation intensity across the bucket's coin-hours
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED only if at least one funding-contrast CI excludes zero AND its Holm adj_p < 0.05 AND materiality effect >= 0.02; otherwise preserve the honest null as NOT_SUPPORTED. Do not threshold-shop; do not relax the 2% floor after seeing outcomes.

constraints.track_separation: observed liquidations (Track A / this campaign) are never conflated with modeled boundary breaches (Track B) or with RV forecasts

cross_reference.question: does the low-RV liquidation funding signal survive a UTC-session-bucketed regime transform instead of the RV-tercile transform
